newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma man kills three sons, then shoots himself.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma man kills three sons, then shoots himself.

text.p: An Oklahoma father shot dead his three young sons on Saturday and then committed suicide by turning the gun on himself, officials said.

Police found Kevin Fox, 32, in critical condition with a gunshot wound to the head at his Oklahoma City home on Saturday morning. They searched the home and found his three sons dead inside their bedrooms. Fox died later in hospital.

The boys were identified as Cody, 11, Cory, 10 and Caleb, 8. Fox left no suicide note but police spokesman Pete Walker said he was recently divorced from his wife and was involved in a battle for custody of the children.
Walker said police were sent to the home after a male relative asked them to check on the family, saying he was worried about their safety.
